$comment: Cloudflare free plan limits the CLI enforces. Each deploy reads this file from the main branch, so older copies of the toolkit follow a change once it is merged. Bump `updated` with every change. translate.dailyChars: characters a day sent to Workers AI for live translation, for the whole account; m2m100-1.2b costs 31,050 Neurons per million input tokens and as many per million output tokens, and the free allocation is 10,000 Neurons a day, so 100,000 characters (about 200,000 tokens in and out, even at one token per character) stays near 6,200.
